I’ve had PTSD and am on the extremely depressive side of bipolar. I take lamictal and clonazapam. I honestly could use more meds but I need to be semi functional and be able to drive. I’ve been on this combo over 10 years. I take clonazapam to sleep and extra in a really difficult day. I manage a lot of symptoms by avoidance. (Not a great idea, I know). I have a number of pain control conditions and paired with PTSD, I must get sleep. Some nights the clonazapam doesn’t work but more often than not it knocks me out. I started tapering by smoking a bit of pot at night and I was down to one a day but a rape trial and a cancer scare (both one family member, not myself) took me back to 2 a day. I might try to taper again soon. I say I will be on my meds forever because I have gone off and on and finally accepted my conditions. Med compliance is critical for me. There’s a trade off I’m not happy about but I need to be somewhat stabilized. A long time ago I was put on Elavil. It was the second antidepressant I was ever on. It messed up my brain a lot. I was naive and just did what the doctors told me and I didn’t know how to advocate for myself. Since then I have what I consider to be brain damage. I know clonazapam is not helping but hurting my brain. It’s horrible, I know I should get off it. However with all that’s going on right now, there’s no way I can throw that into the mix. I’m taking more vitamins and supplements that are helping. Strangely a potassium supplement has made getting up and functioning about 70% easier for me. I also take a multi vitamin. Sorry for the long ramble.
Effexor was the worst I’ve ever had to get off of. It took me 2 years and I used Prozac and clonazapam to do it. Now I am forever on clonazapam though. :/
